thread:
eli-finance: Heads up — account VSP-019 (VesperAI) hit 60d overdue yesterday. Outstanding: $42,800 (INV-2026-0421). Customer claims a legal dispute and asked us to pause collections while they submit MSA redlines. What do we do?

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0421 posted 2026-02-02 • Due 2026-02-28 • Current balance: 42,800.00 USD • https://payments.redwood.com/invoice/INV-2026-0421

sara-billing: I just emailed the AM/legal with the invoice + our standard dunning notice. CS forwarded a redacted clause from their counsel — they boxed out section 8.3 re: liability caps. Customer asked for a 4-month instalment and a pause in automated emails.

marta-cs: Confirming — customer rep says dispute is only over that clause; they offered a 4x instalment: $10,700/mo starting today. They also want limited seat suspension for 2 seats while dispute resolves. They asked CS not to escalate to collections if we accept the instalment.

josh-collections: We can pause automated dunning if Legal confirms a bona fide dispute. Standard collections policy: require signed payment plan + payment authorization before suppressing escalation. If CC auth fails, we resume escalation after 5 business days.

eli-finance: Proposal from finance side: accept the 4-month instalment conditional on (1) signed payment plan (template) and (2) first installment received and cleared. Suppress automated emails & mark account 'temporary-hold' in billing ledger until legal says otherwise. Approve?

sara-billing: I can draft the payment plan and ACH/CC authorization form. Will cc AM and request bank/cc details.

laura-am: AM here — pinged the customer, they agreed to process the first CC charge today pending our confirmation. I'll upload the mandate once they send it. Charging $10,700 now and will follow up with receipt.

paul-legal: Put this on temporary hold from Legal. I need the redlines and our prior MSA (v1.4) to compare. No active collections outreach while I review; we should mute automated emails. If dispute turns out to be non-contractual, we'll lift the hold. ETA: EOD Friday.

josh-collections: Noted. I'll suspend the automated dunning job for VSP-019 and flag the ticket in collections queue with the conditional plan. Condition: signed plan + payment clears before we remove the hold.

billing-bot: Dunning status for VSP-019 updated: PAUSED (hold_reason: legal_dispute_pending) • next_reminder: none • last_actioned_by: josh-collections • 2026-03-11 09:12 UTC

eli-finance: OK — moving forward on that basis. Sara, please attach the draft payment plan and send to customer for signature. Laura, please confirm when the first CC hits. Josh/Paul — let me know if either of you want different conditions.

sara-billing: Draft sent to customer and AM. Link to doc: https://docs.redwood.com/drafts/VSP-019-paymentplan (internal).

laura-am: CC auth succeeded (pending capture). I captured $10,700 — appears as pending clearance. I emailed the mandate.

eli-finance: Thanks — once cleared we'll record the schedule and mark account as 'on-payment-plan'.

paul-legal: Received the redlines. Quick read shows a narrow dispute. I'll escalate internally but current guidance stands: no collections until I sign off or we see bad faith.

josh-collections: Will hold escalation. Creating follow-up tickler for 7 days after payment clears.

eli-finance: Closing the loop here. We'll reconvene if payment fails or Legal flips. :thumbsup:
